sql.value: select d.id, d.name, d.type, d.size, d.file_path, d.status, d.chunk_count, d.chunk_strategy, d.chunk_size, d.chunk_overlap, d.error_msg, d.kb_id, d.create_by, d.create_time, d.update_by, d.update_time, d.is_deleted, d.revision, k.name as kb_name from ai_document d left join ai_knowledge_base k on k.id = d.kb_id where d.is_deleted=0 #[and d.name like :name] #[and d.type = :type] #[and d.status = :status] #[and d.kb_id = :kbId] order by d.create_time desc
